scope: art-only; proposed client presentation, simulation unchanged
color_family: black energy with indigo planes and violet rim light

shadow-coil.png.texture_filter: linear; clamp to frame interior; no mipmaps

shadow-streak.png.texture_filter: linear; clamp to frame interior; no mipmaps

geometry.placement: Align source_tail to start and source_tip to landing; angle follows world travel direction. If camera squashes Y, derive angle and distance after projecting endpoints.
geometry.short_dash: Keep 12 screen-px thickness at 30 px travel; do not uniformly scale thickness with distance.

shadow-afterimage.png.texture_filter: linear; clamp to frame interior; no mipmaps
shadow-afterimage.png.note: Neutral grayscale ink sprite. White tint preserves neutral black; suggested violet tint multiplies. 40 px canvas contains about 32 px high painted silhouette.

shadow-impact.png.texture_filter: linear; clamp to frame interior; no mipmaps
shadow-impact.png.note: Frame 0 starts on authoritative impact event. Maximum burst is frame 2, 33 ms after event. Flash core is baked into the alpha sprite; optional additive duplicate is omitted to preserve black shards.

shadow-crack.png.texture_filter: linear; clamp to frame interior; no mipmaps

shadow-dissipate.png.texture_filter: linear; clamp to frame interior; no mipmaps
shadow-dissipate.png.note: Pivot sits low in frame; anchor at landing foot position. Fading is baked into frames; optional overall fade only.

timeline.authoritative_anchor: simulation impact frame / impact_at; damage remains 240% in simulation
timeline.scheduling: Snapshot departure, target impact position and landing behind target at cue time. Scale anticipation to available lead-in if under 220 ms. Never delay damage or infer impact from animation completion. Late event starts impact immediately and skips elapsed anticipation.

afterimages.spacing: equal along path at 0.20, 0.45, 0.70; optional fourth at 0.85 for paths longer than 100 screen px
afterimages.fade: linear to zero; oldest stamp is faintest
afterimages.anchor: body center; match Hondo facing, retain body upright; rotate streak only

screen_shake.envelope: quick onset then linear decay; camera presentation only

visual_hit_stop.scope: hold attacker/target presentation pose only; sim, input and damage advance normally; effect clocks continue

preview.note: Static compositing mockup; not runtime capture. Arena crop uses camera zoom 0.5 and ground Y squash 0.75. Effects and actors use unsquashed sprite sizes.
